title: How many keys come before this one?
hook: A search path can account for unseen smaller keys.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Accumulate skipped left subtrees while computing a key's rank.

misconception: A key's depth gives its sorted rank.
objective: Accumulate skipped left subtrees while computing a key's rank.

claims.text: Moving right passes every key in the left subtree plus the parent. Summing those skipped groups recovers the global rank; counting only the visited nodes would lose the unseen smaller keys.
